evidence.recognition: The identify box names the reader's exact behavior: "We have had one real conversation. I have replayed it..."
evidence.mechanism: Cause is separated from symptom: "wanting somebody runs as a goal rather than as a mood," plus the uncertainty loop.
evidence.honesty: It grades its own label: "Thin, older than it looks," and "There is no accepted measurement instrument."
evidence.ownership: The whole prescription is solo ("Nothing, for seven days, except watching"), though a seminar pitch follows it.
evidence.clarity: The answer box is plain and short ("the least available person ends up producing the most thought").
